scope: Isolated tagged primary-source event registration and dispatch contract. Actual unmodified Magento Config DOM merger, Event Converter, Event Manager, InvokerDefault, ObserverFactory and FrontController run with explicit infrastructure doubles. Not a Magento installation, browser or live server test.

old_registration_fixture.source: Previously validated 1.1.5 module frontend events XML; used only as the initial old registration in native DOM merge.

probe.location: Private route-fix test workspace, outside extension runtime

native_executed: Config\Dom constructor/merge/getDom with real DOMDocument and exact id paths declared in primary Event\Config\Reader
Event\Manager constructor/dispatch with native Event constructor and native Observer payload
DataObject getters/setters, native Event constructor/name and native Observer::getEvent
Module EnforcePurchasingPolicy::execute and actual modern Submit::execute
native_contract_notes: No native constructor is bypassed by Reflection. All loaded native sources are unmodified.
Event manager tracking subclass records inputs and immediately calls unmodified parent::dispatch. Factory records are collected by the explicit ObjectManager double after actual ObserverFactory::get.
Exact Event Reader id paths are verified against primary source; full Config Reader filesystem discovery, cache and full platform configuration merge are not run.

Native DOM merge is supplied actual module etc/events.xml, old 1.1.5 frontend events.xml, then current frontend events.xml. It retains the old instance attribute and sets disabled=true; actual InvokerDefault returns before any factory lookup.
Current fresh XML is separately merged and converted. Actual Submit dispatch is exercised with both fresh and old/current merged configurations.
PurchasingPolicy remains a decision/context-recording double in this native registration probe; unit/integration assets separately cover its actual implementation.
2.4.8-p5 cached reference has no Reports product View controller: that route uses an explicit modern action shape; 2.4.9 uses native View with reporting disabled.
Saved quote context uses current store null and saved quote store 7. All three purchase routes check both contexts when a saved quote exists; denial of saved quote prevents action execution.

Quote, reports and customer/section/load routes have zero purchasing policy calls and zero observer factory requests. Checkout success/failure still instantiate the scoped new guard but exit before policy checks.
No user-provided session cookies, real customer email, request token or remote endpoint were replayed.
The quote token action is a synthetic modern-action shape used for route exclusion; the module declares no token controller. The actual request token is generated by its AMD handler.
